source.quote: Audiophile Style, thread "HQPlayer settings for specific DACs", the author's replies : « Less is More (its a 16-bit TI DAC) » ; PCM only, 192 kHz. Chip: four TI DAC8812 16-bit converters, per 6moons and Schiit's own product page read 2026-11-20.

facts.chip: Four TI DAC8812, 16-bit. The maker's multibit line uses ladder parts rather than delta-sigma; the other two Yggdrasil variants use Analog Devices AD5791 and TI DAC11001, both 20-bit.
